Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a synthetic bicistronic mRNA system to compare how different synonymous recodings of an upstream ORF (shble) affect the translation of both the upstream and downstream (GFP) proteins. The primary biological variable is the genetic sequence variation (synonymous mutations) and the presence/absence of splicing signals.
